Their contributions primarily involve clarifying documentation, managing dependencies, and implementing security best practices rather than writing new code. While there is no visible implementation of backend APIs or frontend code, their contributions to versioning automation and security improvements indicate a strategic mindset in maintaining robust and secure Node.js ecosystems.
